summary: Frontend-only test of the FMCC clean-up round (desktop 1920 and mobile 390). Working: deep links in fresh contexts (/scouting?tab=watchlist, /squad, /settings?section=safety, /appearance, /features, /connections, /safety, /moneyball all land on the right page/section, tour does not hijack; tour only auto-starts from Home and then goes to /matches as designed). Player panel opens from Scout row, Squad Players row, Club Analysis idea row, Transfer Market row, Stats Table row and /squad?player=<own uid>. All 5 tabs render with no errors, own vs not-own actions are correct, no CA/PA numbers found, and closing removes ?player. Settings: 6 section tabs switch and update the URL; 'What the game calls you' is the first card, auto-read is in career, guides switch and tour are in Alerts; footer links open their sections and only the matching link is highlighted; safety-open-changes goes to /changes. Scout Players: 6 main tabs, all 17 legacy ?tab= keys map correctly, Moneyball view shows moneyball-view above the table, Tools has 4 groups, Lists has 3 sub-tabs plus the explainer, and Compare with 3 players renders Radar / Side by side / Stat breakdown. Guide link toggles the box, X hides it, and the Settings switch brings it back. Finance strip is on the 6 MONEY routes, aligned with the guide card (x=316, w=1568), and absent elsewhere. More menu: all 4 items work, the raw toggle switches and was restored. Sidebar says 'Monthly Awards'. The DoF button is rgb(231,42,44) with no gradient or shadow, white text and a focus ring. Mobile: no page overflow, top bar fits, finance strip stays on one line and scrolls, panel is full width. No page errors on 19 routes. Found 1 high bug (Compare from the panel when the URL is already /scouting?tab=compare) and 1 medium bug (screen tips never show).

ui_bugs.issue: When the current URL is already /scouting?tab=compare (for example: open Compare, go to Find players, click a row, press Compare), the success toast shows but the player is NOT added (localStorage scout-compare does not change, even after a reload) and the main tab stays on Find players. Reproduced 3 of 3 times. Compare from other pages (Transfer Market) and from /scouting?tab=players works.

Screen tips never actually show. On the first visit Tip mounts for one render and its useEffect writes fmcc-tips-seen[path]=true. Then the ModuleGuide first-visit effect opens the guide box, which takes the Tip's place. Hiding or closing the guide later shows no tip. Checked on /scouting: screen-tip count was 0 at 300ms, at 3s and after hiding the guide, while LS fmcc-tips-seen={'/scouting':true}.
The panel scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 445 vs clientWidth 389). The 'Seasons in this career' table is wider than its card; the npxG/xA columns are cut off.

integration_issues.flow: Compare from the panel while on /scouting?tab=compare
integration_issues.issue: See ui_bugs[0]. The tab switch relies on a URL change that never happens.

issues: guides-open stays true after the first visit, so the box opens on every later visit until the user presses Hide. The spec says 'box opens on first visit only'. Confirm the intent: if the box should be collapsed on later visits, reset open[path] when leaving the page.
top-search-button is hidden at 390px, so there is no search in the mobile top bar. The spec lists search in the top bar; confirm this is intended.
No guide-link or module guide (no GUIDES entry), unlike other main modules
The whatchanged-all-changes link to /changes only renders when there are changes. In the 'Nothing changed' state there is no link to Game changes (sample digest total=0).
The sticky footer wraps to 2 lines (~72px) at 390px and takes up vertical space

action_items: Fix panel Compare: (a) usePersist.set does its localStorage write inside the setV updater, and Actions unmounts straight away (close() sets uid=null), so React can drop the queued updater. Compute the next value from read(cid,key) synchronously and write localStorage before calling setV, or do the add through PlayerPanelHost's setCompare, which stays mounted. (b) Scouting reads ?tab only from window.location.search in an effect keyed on `start`. Navigating to the same URL does not re-run it, so also set the persisted 'scout-main' to 'compare' from Actions (or key the effect on location.key).

Fix screen tips: mark a tip as seen only after it has actually rendered (or when dismissed), and do not let the first-visit guide box hide it. For example, show the tip on the second visit, or show it alongside the collapsed guide link.
Wrap the seasons table in the panel History tab in overflow-x:auto so the panel does not scroll sideways on mobile

Optional: decide whether the guide box should collapse after the first visit; add GUIDES for /club-analysis and /transfer-market; show the /changes link in the What changed empty state; reconsider hiding search on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: lib/remember usePersist.set: side effects (localStorage write and event dispatch) inside a React state updater are not reliable. Updaters can be dropped on unmount and run twice in StrictMode.
PlayerPanelHost: the ?player= effect sets uid but does not reset tab to 'overview', so opening by URL after browsing another player keeps the old tab.
Actions 'Open in Squad' only goes to /squad and does not focus or highlight the player row (it is a no-op when already on /squad apart from closing the panel).
Editor page asks for /api/editor/image/face/<uid> for every player and gets about 60 404s, which fill the console. Consider an exists-flag or a list endpoint.

Game changes count badge (top-changes-count) could not be checked: the queue was empty, review_changes=false, and I did not queue a change to avoid editing the save. The code (pending from /api/changes queued.length) looks correct.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (2 functional bugs found in about 60 checks)

seed_data_creation: None. No server-side writes: did not click Shortlist, Watch, Try XI, Send to FM or Read save. The compare list was only in local storage of throwaway browser contexts and was cleared. The raw numbers toggle was switched back off, the guides switch was left on and the tour was skipped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call starts with fresh localStorage, so the tour auto-starts only on '/' and jumps to /matches; click tour-skip. Squad rows appear only after clicking squad-view-tab-players. The panel slides in: wait about 1s after player-panel-actions appears, or use element.evaluate('e=>e.click()'). Own uid 20481110; others 305000xx. Repro for the compare bug: open /scouting?tab=compare, click scout-main-tab-players, click any sp-row, then profile-compare, and check localStorage *:scout-compare. Tools sub-tab ids are tools-<group-slug>-tab-<key>, e.g. tools-more-analysis-tab-stats.
rca of the issue: Compare bug: Scouting.jsx maps ?tab once per change of `start` (window.location.search). nav('/scouting?tab=compare') from the same URL does not change it, so the tab does not switch. The player is not saved because usePersist's set writes localStorage inside setV's updater, and Actions unmounts in the same batch (close() sets uid to null), so React drops the update. Steps to reproduce are in context_for_next_testing_agent. Tips bug: Tip's mount effect writes seen=true before ModuleGuide's first-visit effect opens the guide box, which replaces the Tip.
